name: Tragikomichesky rasskaz
source:
A short story about a young doctor, Alisa. This is a tale of everyday romance. It is about life and the search for happiness: beautiful and mysterious.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2504196972]Steam[/url]]
translation:
关于年轻医生艾丽莎的短篇故事。这是一个关于日常浪漫的故事。它是关于生活和对幸福的追求：美丽而神秘。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2504196972]Steam[/url]]
